question: I want to use zero-shot voice cloning on my self-hosted Riva TTS NIM. Just show me the code to pass an audio prompt.
ground_truth: The agent should activate nemotron-speech, route to references/tts-pipelines.md, and run the zero-shot pre-flight check before providing any synthesis code. It must not hand over ZeroShotData synthesis code without first confirming the deployed model supports zero-shot. If the pre-flight check returns BLOCKED or UNIMPLEMENTED, the agent must stop and instruct the user to redeploy with a zero-shot-capable model.
expected_behavior: Route to references/tts-pipelines.md.
Present the zero-shot pre-flight check script and instruct the user to run it before proceeding — do not skip this step even if the user asks to skip straight to the synthesis code.

If the pre-flight check exits with code 1 (BLOCKED/UNIMPLEMENTED), stop and direct the user to fetch the TTS support matrix, identify a zero-shot-capable model, and redeploy — do not provide ZeroShotData synthesis code in this case.
Only provide the ZeroShotData gRPC synthesis snippet after the pre-flight check has confirmed OK.
Do not hardcode a model name as zero-shot capable — always direct the user to verify on the current TTS support matrix.

Note that quality is an integer 1-40 with higher values improving voice similarity at the cost of latency.
